intent.note: Task clause: judge the growth exponent over the series, or a least-squares slope of log time over log length, and say why. Diff: _growth_exponent (tests/test__clause_coverage.py:1542-1551) is the least-squares slope of log2 time over log2 length, with the reason in its docstring (every length votes; one noisy length moves only a share), and _run_faults faults on exponent > WIDE_POWER. I recomputed the slopes: the two CI series read 1.02 (windows 2.04/1.53/2.92) and 0.75 (linux 1.17/1.43/3.00), green; ratios 2,4,4 read 1.7 and a quadratic reads 2, red. The old inline block on run fault that the floor guard could not compare moved into _run_faults with the same sentence and an early return, so behaviour is preserved. One addition beyond the clause: a series of the wrong length is now a fault. The executor's claim matches the diff: cw17-cw20 judge fixed series with no child, cw8 still runs the real child, and the dependants (sweep-costs.json, _clause_coverage.py, CHANGELOG.md:547, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md) are untouched by the diff and the stated reasons hold. The task asked for quadratic over the series or over its last two doublings, which is what is pinned.
